channel.title: Joseph A. Lotozo — Blog
channel.description: Building things with AI, community notes, family trips, and life in Upper Arlington, Ohio.

item.title: How I Helped a Classmate Get His Food Truck Dream Rolling
item.description: A classmate in my MBA program is building a dosa food truck. Here's how I used a little tech and a lot of community to help him get noticed — a spotlight, social reach, and an introduction to my Columbus networking group.

item.title: I Joined My MBA Student Council. Then I Built Us a Website.
item.description: How Joe Lotozo used Claude Code to build a website for the Ohio State Fisher Working Professional MBA Student Council — in an afternoon, with zero coding experience.

item.title: She Was There When My Daughters Were Born. I Built Her Website.
item.description: Pat Dodge was our doula for three births. Now she's an end-of-life midwife — and I used Claude Code to build her a website in about three hours.

item.title: Building a Cancer Clinical Trial Finder With ChatGPT Codex
item.description: How my aunt Jane's idea for a cancer clinical trial finder became Cancer Trial Compass, an AI-assisted app built with ChatGPT Codex, React, Firebase, and ClinicalTrials.gov data.

item.title: My Brother Has Been Shooting Film for Years. I Finally Built Him a Website.
item.description: My brother Tom has been shooting 35mm film photography for years — landscapes, travel, portraits. He had an Instagram and a stack of negatives. What he didn't have was a website. So I built him one.

item.title: I Built It in a Night. I Didn't Stop There.
item.description: StreamNChill started as a one-night experiment. Two weeks later it has Watch Together, a Wrapped Card, Face ID sign-in, and a dozen other features. Here's what happened.

item.title: My Mom Gave Me an App Idea. I Built It That Night.
item.description: How a casual suggestion from my mom turned into a full AI-powered streaming tracker — built overnight with Claude Code, no developer required.

item.title: I Built a Drink Tracker App With AI — Here's What Happened
item.description: How Joe Lotozo used Claude to build Sip Tracker — a personal drink and calorie logging app — with no coding background and a single afternoon.

item.title: Tornadoes, Soul Food, and the Edge of America
item.description: Our spring break road trip to Folly Beach, SC — with a tornado warning in a 300-year-old Moravian building, soul food where George Washington ate, jellyfish at the pier, and a country deli that surprised us on the way home.

item.title: Uncle Robbie's Picks: Building a Sports App in 24 Hours
item.description: What happens when a non-developer, his brother-in-law, and an AI spend 24 hours trying to build a live MLB prop bet app from scratch. A story about curiosity, debugging, and deploying something real.

item.title: Building My Mom's Law Firm Website with AI
item.description: How Joe Lotozo used Claude Code to build a professional website for his mother's estate planning law practice — with zero coding experience and zero budget.

item.title: I Have a Genie and His Name is Claude
item.description: How Joe Lotozo used Claude Code and AI to build an interactive Chamber Wrapped presentation with zero coding experience — and why the speech itself had to be his own.
